meta.name: test-driven-development
meta.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

copy.tagline: 先写测试再实现代码，确保功能正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用测试驱动开发来保证代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Write tests before implementation to ensure correctness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to practice test-driven development

howto.what: 当您要求实现功能或修复bug时，Claude会严格遵循测试驱动开发：先让您写出会失败的测试，再写恰好通过测试的最小代码，最后重构，并确保每个测试都看到其失败和成功。
howto.when: 当您要求实现新功能、修复bug、重构或改变行为时触发。如果涉及一次性原型或配置文件，Claude会先征得您同意是否跳过TDD。

say.text: 帮我实现一个用户注册功能，请先写测试。
say.note: Claude会先编写一个失败测试，再写实现代码。

say.text: 修复空邮箱被接受的bug，请先写测试复现。
say.note: Claude会先写一个验证bug的测试，看到它失败后再修复。
Claude会在保证测试全部通过的前提下优化结构。

howto.what_en: When you ask to implement a feature or fix a bug, Claude strictly follows test-driven development: first write a failing test, then minimal code to pass, then refactor, ensuring each test is seen to fail and pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request new features, bug fixes, refactoring, or behavior changes. For throwaway prototypes or config files, Claude will ask your permission to skip TDD.

say_en.text: Implement user registration with TDD, start by writing a test.
say_en.note: Claude will write a failing test first, then the implementation.

say_en.text: Fix the bug where empty email is accepted, write a test first.
say_en.note: Claude will write a test that reproduces the bug, see it fail, then fix.
Claude will ensure all tests pass before and after refactoring.
